ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced field hand
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a compact agricultural hand replacement with telescoping tools that sow several holes or harvest multiple points at once. A general-purpose manipulator handles other tasks, and the assembly folds away to avoid the movement penalty of the older design.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic hand talon
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a razor-sharp talon which extends from a hidden opening between the middle and ring fingers. The talon is longer than the palm, but it becomes flexible upon retracting, allowing the user to curl it up and conceal it inside the palm of the bionic hand.
This weapon system have been integrated into a bionic hand, at a small cost to the efficiency of the original bionic hand. No longer needing to be careful in not injuring the user's biological hand, the hand talons are now sharper than ever.
